patterns.note: Asymmetrical layout with large, full-bleed photographic content dominating the visual space, often paired with minimal text blocks.

The left half of the initial hero image sticks to the viewport's left edge and expands vertically, acting as a persistent visual anchor while the main content scrolls underneath it, eventually revealing the full page. The main navigation also sticks to the top left.
A stark black and white base palette is used for structural elements and text, allowing vibrant, high-quality photography to provide the primary color and visual interest.
A horizontal scrolling gallery is used at the bottom of the page to showcase project previews, breaking from the vertical scroll flow.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is fixed to the top left of the viewport. A prominent hero image element is positioned to cover the left side of the screen and maintains its position as the page content scrolls beneath it, creating a layered reveal effect where new sections slide in from the right. The bottom section uses a horizontally scrolling container for a gallery of project thumbnails.

design_tokens.type_scale: Subtle hierarchy with relatively small body text and moderately larger headings, all in a clean sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with an airy initial hero section transitioning to a more standard content density.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the persistent, sticky left-aligned hero image that acts as a dynamic visual anchor, revealing content underneath it as the user scrolls. This creates a unique, layered browsing experience that elevates the photographic portfolio.
